goal: Permit a verified non-migration rename to use the repository-maintenance reviewer and merge route while refusing incomplete or conflicting file inventory
dispatcher: child issue #3607 and parent Codex session
prohibited_actions: Do not relax migration-side rename admission
Do not change database structure or rows
Do not alter any db-claim lease, #3505, or #3552
assumptions: GraphQL file snapshots omit prior filenames while the paginated REST PR file reader returns them
A complete, matching GraphQL and REST inventory with readable prior paths can route non-migration renames as repository maintenance
stop_conditions: Stop if a rename cannot be bound to a complete matching current-head file inventory
Stop if any migration-side path could enter the repository-maintenance route
Stop if implementation needs a file outside the allowed paths
